title: UAAP: Tams torch Bulldogs to inch closer to Final Four berth
summary: Far Eastern University caught fire to dominate National University, 85-63, and inch closer to a Final Four berth in UAAP Season 89 men's basketball on Sunday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.
